title: fix(lint): flow trigger rule counts the objects of a manifest's declared dependencies
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9D7K4emLL9dNcp4rQPn22Dw)_

Fixes #34616

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** lint 规则 `flow-trigger-unknown-object`(和共用同一份对象名单的 `flow-input-unknown-object`)在 CLI 的按包检查里，现在也把本包 manifest `dependencies` 声明的依赖包(传递)里的对象算作已定义。对象从多包制品自带的 `packages[]` 读取，依赖闭包用发布门同一个 `resolvePackageClosure` 走。
- **为什么改：** 包 B 依赖包 A,B 的记录触发流程挂在 A 的对象上时，按包检查只看 B 自己的对象，于是告警;`os lint --strict` 把这条告警当失败，而运行时发布门按 B 的依赖闭包判同一个流程是放行的。hotcrm#2556(费用模块)被这个卡住。
- **风险与回滚：** 只会少报，不会多报。没声明依赖的兄弟包、闭包里没有的名字照旧告警;发布门声明了闭包时行为不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/lint/src/validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts` 新增的 `dependencyClosureObjectNames` 和 `validateFlowTriggerReadiness` 里加名字的那一行。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-flow-trigger-readiness.test.ts`,预期 148 个全过。
- **需要你做的：** 不需要。区线程审核后合入。

## What changes

- `packages/lint/src/validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts`: with no package closure stated (the three CLI doors), the rule's set of defined object names now also holds the objects of the packages the stack's manifest declares in `dependencies`, walked transitively by `resolvePackageClosure` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`, the publish gate's own walk, ruling #9612) over the artifact's `packages[]` entries. That is the resolution context `runPerPackageAuthoringRules` already hands every package's stack (`packageBodyAsStack`, ADR-0130 D4); the rule simply never read it. Both positions that read the set get the same answer: the start node's trigger object (`flow-trigger-unknown-object`) and a start input declared a record (`flow-input-unknown-object`, #29442). Under a stated closure nothing is added, since `stack.objects` already is the closure. The Severity section and the `validateFlowTriggerReadiness` docblock say so.
- The closure, not every `packages[]` entry: a sibling package B did not declare is outside what the publish gate lets B bind a flow to, so its object keeps the advisory, whose remedy (declare the dependency) is the gate's. This is the card's re-check: drop the dependency and `os lint --strict` fails again.
- A dependency the artifact does not carry adds nothing (its objects are not in the stack to read), so ADR-0141 D1's statement that build and lint warn on such a dependency's object is unchanged.
- `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`: the `os explain` text of both ids says the rule counts a declared dependency's objects when the artifact carries them.
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`: the per-package walk paragraph says a flow's trigger object and a start input's record object resolve only through the declared dependency closure.
- No CLI source change, and the CLI still sets no `packageScope`.

## Tests

- `validate-flow-trigger-readiness.test.ts`, new group `[#34616] a declared dependency carried in packages[] provides the object` (7 cases): the declared dependency's object is not flagged; without the dependency the same flow warns (`warning`, at the trigger path); the closure is transitive; a declared dependency the artifact does not carry provides nothing; a misspelt name keeps its finding; a start input on the dependency's object is not flagged, and is flagged without the dependency; under a stated closure the stack is the closure and the finding stays an `error`.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/artifact-packages.test.ts`, the card's two-package fixture through `runPerPackageAuthoringRules` with the `lint` command: CONTROL, without the dependency the pass advises at `package 'com.example.psa' — flow "report_submitted" › start node`; with it declared, no `flow-trigger-unknown-object`.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): the line that adds the closure's names disabled, 3 of 148 red in the rule's test file (the declared-dependency, transitive and start-input cases); restored, 148 of 148.

## Reading (the card's re-check, a real `os lint --strict`)

`examples/app-multi-package` (the `orders` package declares `dependencies: { 'com.example.multi.core': '^1.0.0' }`) with a probe flow added to `orders`, record-after-create on core's `crm_account`, and `requires: ['automation', 'triggers']`; not committed:

| rule build | dependency | `flow-trigger-unknown-object` | warnings |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `origin/main` | declared | yes, `package 'com.example.multi.orders'` | 4 |
| this PR | declared | no | 3 |
| this PR | dropped | yes | 4 |

The 3 that remain are `field-no-consumers` on the example's own fields, unrelated to this card, so the example itself still exits 1 under `--strict`; the reading is about the one id.

## Verification

At head 87e47ab9 (the docs commit added after f2f2a845): `dispatch-gates --commands` now derives 100 families; the 29 the docs path added were run, all exit 0, and `--ran` on the combined record reads `100 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 100 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. No code changed after f2f2a845.

At head f2f2a845:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: exit 0, `Test Files 214 passed (214)`, `Tests 9098 passed (9098)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/utils/artifact-packages.test.ts src/utils/author-time-rules.test.ts`: exit 0, 10 passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 71 families, all run with `< /dev/null`, exit codes captured before any pipe. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` first exited 3 (unbuilt packages); after building the 35 packages without `dist/` both exited 0. `--ran` on the final record: `71 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
